mapper.select: SELECT A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.TARGET_TYPE, A.APPROVER_DEPT_ID, TARGET_DEPT.DEPT_NAME AS APPROVER_DEPT_NAME, A.APPROVER_ID, U.USER_NAME AS APPROVER_NAME, CASE WHEN A.TARGET_TYPE = 'DEPARTMENT' THEN TARGET_DEPT.DEPT_NAME ELSE D.DEPT_NAME END AS DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME, A.STATUS, A.COMMENT_TEXT, A.CREATED_AT, A.DECIDED_AT FROM APPROVAL A LEFT JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = A.APPROVER_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT TARGET_DEPT ON TARGET_DEPT.DEPT_ID = A.APPROVER_DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} ORDER BY A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_ID
mapper.sql: AND U.USER_ID = #{approverId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND A.STATUS = 'PENDING' AND ( ( A.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND A.APPROVER_ID = U.USER_ID ) OR ( A.TARGET_TYPE = 'DEPARTMENT' AND A.APPROVER_DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID AND A.APPROVER_ID IS NULL ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUERY_REQUEST Q WHERE Q.REQUEST_ID = A.REQUEST_ID AND Q.REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND Q.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND ( Q.DRAFTER_ID <> U.USER_ID OR ( A.TARGET_TYPE = 'USER' AND A.APPROVAL_TYPE = 'DIRECTOR' ) ) ) AND ( A.APPROVAL_TYPE IN ('APPROVER', 'INTERMEDIATE') OR ( A.APPROVAL_TYPE = 'DIRECTOR' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM QUERY_REQUEST Q JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE Q.REQUEST_ID = A.REQUEST_ID AND Q.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID AND P.POSITION_CODE = 'DIRECTOR' ) ) OR ( A.APPROVAL_TYPE = 'DB_EXECUTION' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DEPARTMENT D WHERE D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID AND D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'DB_APPROVER' ) ) )
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.REQUEST_TYPE, R.TITLE, R.PURPOSE, DU.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, R.SUBMITTED_AT, A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE FROM APPROVAL A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = #{approverId} JOIN QUERY_REQUEST R ON R.REQUEST_ID = A.REQUEST_ID JOIN USERS DU ON DU.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY R.SUBMITTED_AT DESC NULLS LAST, R.REQUEST_ID DESC

SELECT R.REQUEST_ID, R.REQUEST_NO, R.REQUEST_TYPE, R.TITLE, R.PURPOSE, R.DETAIL_CONTENT, R.IS_URGENT, R.DESIRED_DATE, DU.USER_NAME AS DRAFTER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, R.REQUEST_CLASS, R.REQUEST_STATUS, R.APPROVAL_STATUS, R.CREATED_AT, R.SUBMITTED_AT FROM QUERY_REQUEST R JOIN USERS DU ON DU.USER_ID = R.DRAFTER_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = R.DEPT_ID WHERE R.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM APPROVAL A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = #{approverId} WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = R.REQUEST_ID
)
SELECT REQUEST_ID, DRAFTER_ID, DEPT_ID, REQUEST_STATUS FROM QUERY_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE U.DEPT_ID = #{deptId} AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND P.POSITION_CODE = 'DIRECTOR' ORDER BY U.USER_ID

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, D.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID JOIN USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE D.DEPT_NAME = 'DB팀' AND U.ENABLED = 'Y' AND R.ROLE_CODE = 'DB_APPROVER' AND U.USER_ID <> #{departmentApproverId} ORDER BY U.USER_NAME, U.USER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APPROVAL ( APPROVAL_ID, REQUEST_ID, APPROVER_ID, APPROVAL_ORDER, APPROVAL_TYPE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_APPROVAL.NEXTVAL, #{requestId}, #{approverId}, #{approvalOrder}, #{approvalType}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP )

INSERT INTO APPROVAL ( APPROVAL_ID, REQUEST_ID, TARGET_TYPE, APPROVER_ID, APPROVER_DEPT_ID, APPROVAL_ORDER, APPROVAL_TYPE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_APPROVAL.NEXTVAL, #{requestId}, #{targetType}, #{approverId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{approverDeptId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{approvalOrder}, #{approvalType}, #{status}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT REQUEST_ID, DRAFTER_ID, REQUEST_STATUS, APPROVAL_STATUS FROM QUERY_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT A.APPROVAL_ID, A.APPROVAL_ORDER, A.APPROVAL_TYPE FROM APPROVAL A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = #{approverId} WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}
FOR UPDATE OF A.APPROVAL_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE APPROVAL SET STATUS = 'PENDING' WHERE APPROVAL_ID = ( SELECT APPROVAL_ID FROM ( SELECT APPROVAL_ID FROM APPROVAL WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'WAITING' ORDER BY APPROVAL_ORDER ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 )

UPDATE QUERY_REQUEST Q SET APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED', REQUEST_STATUS = 'READY' WHERE Q.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND Q.APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND Q.REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM APPROVAL A WHERE A.REQUEST_ID = Q.REQUEST_ID AND A.STATUS <> 'APPROVED' )

UPDATE APPROVAL A SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', APPROVER_ID = #{approverId}, COMMENT_TEXT = #{commentText}, DECIDED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE A.APPROVAL_ID = #{approvalId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERS U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{approverId}
)
UPDATE APPROVAL SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED' WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
UPDATE QUERY_REQUEST SET APPROVAL_STATUS = 'REJECTED', REQUEST_STATUS = 'REJECTED' WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND REQUEST_STATUS = 'PENDING_APPROVAL'
